description: Use when two parties (agents, bots, contracts) have ALREADY agreed on a trade and just need a trustless way to swap: returns the signed createDeal transaction for an atomic escrow settlement on Bull. No account, no signature, no RFQ needed. On Robinhood Chain pay in ETH or USDG; on Base (chain "base") pay in USDC. The fee is returned in the response. Next call bull_settle_steps with the dealId and the same chain. Base: unaudited contracts, not yet tested with a live deal.

buyer.description: Wallet of the side that pays. It sends the createDeal transaction.

chain.description: robinhood (default), base or solana. Base: USDC, the signature and fee quote are bound to Base's escrow. Unaudited contracts, no live Base deal tested yet.

consentOnly.description: true = return the typed data (EIP-712) the SELLER must sign. Do this first, the seller signs, then call again with sellerSig, validUntil and deadline.

deadline.description: Unix time of the deal deadline, fixed inside the consent (returned by consentOnly).

deadlineHours.description: Hours until anyone can cancel and refund both sides. Default 24, max 168.

payAmount.description: What the buyer pays, in the pay asset (ETH, USDG or USDC), e.g. "0.25".

sellToken.description: Token contract address the seller delivers (an ERC-20 on the chosen chain).

seller.description: Wallet of the side that delivers the tokens.

sellerSig.description: The seller's EIP-712 signature over the consent typed data. Required to get the createDeal transaction.

validUntil.description: Unix time until which the seller's consent is valid (returned by consentOnly).

name: bull_settle
